Property.Name: mipi-sdw-sw-interface-revision
Property.Description: This Property is deprecated but is mandatory for backwards compatibility. It shall be set to 0x00020002, which indicates to legacy software that the DisCo content is compatible with, but not identical to, legacy DisCo for SoundWire 2.1 content.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-function-topology-features
Property.Description: This Property shall contain a 64-bit bitmask indicating which Optional Features this SDCA Function supports. Values: A value of 0b1 in a bit shall indicate that the Optional Feature is supported; 0b0 shall indicate that the Optional Feature is not supported. Default: If this Property is not present, then the Host shall assume that this SDCA Function does not support any optional features.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-function-topology-pipe-n-features
Property.Description: This property should be user edited and duplicated as needed, replacing n with the a number as fit (e.g. mipi-sdca-function-topology-pipe-1-features). This Property shall contain a 64-bit bitmask indicating which Optional Features this SDCA Function supports. Values: A value of 0b1 in a bit shall indicate that the Optional Feature is supported; 0b0 shall indicate that the Optional Feature is not supported. Conditions: This Property shall be present if this SDCA NDAI Function supports any optional features. Default: If this Property is not present, then the Host shall assume that this SDCA Function does not support any optional features.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-list
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate which Function-Level Control Selectors are present for this SDCA Function. Values: Bit 0 maps to Control Selector 0, bit 18 maps to Control Selector 18, etc. A value of 0b1 in a bit indicates that the Control Selector is supported; 0b0 means the Control Selector is not supported.

Package.Name: Sdca_ControlSelector
Package.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to a package describing properties for each control selector. n is encoded as a hexadecimal integer. n equals to each but that is set in mipi-sdca-control-selector-list, encoded as a capitalized hex number without any leading zeros (i.e. %X not %8X or %8x). See Table 19 Control Descriptor for package contents.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-entity-id-list
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate which Function-Level Control Selectors are present for this SDCA Function. Values: Bit 0 maps to Control Selector 0, bit 18 maps to Control Selector 18, etc. A value of 0b1 in a bit indicates that the Control Selector is supported; 0b0 means the Control Selector is not supported.

Package.Name: Sdca_Entity
Package.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to a package describing properties for each entity. n is encoded as a hexadecimal integer and there shall be one entry for each entity id mentioned in mipi-sdca-entity-id-list. See Table 4 – Table 18 for package contents.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-function-agent-entity-id-list
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating which Entities are present in the Function Agent associated with this SDCA Function, with one integer entry for each Entity ID.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-external-interface-agent-entity-id-list
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating which Entities are present in the External Interface Agent associated with this SDCA Function, with one integer entry for each Entity ID.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-cluster-id-list
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating which Clusters are present for this SDCA Function, with one integer entry for each Cluster ID. See Section 14.5. Example: Package() {0x11, 0x23, 0x54, 0x55, 0x9, 0x12} Conditions: This Property shall be present if this SDCA Function implements any Clusters.

Package.Name: Sdca_Cluster
Package.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to a package describing properties for each cluster. n is encoded as a hexadecimal integer and there shall be one entry for each cluster id mentioned in mipi-sdca-cluster-id-list. See Table 25 Cluster Descriptor for package contents.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-opaqueset-rank
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate whether OpaqueSets for this SDCA Function are Single-Ranked or Dual- Ranked. This applies to all OpaqueSets described in Property mipi-sdca-opaqueset-id-list for this SDCA Function. Values: DisCo_False: Single-Ranked DisCo_True: Dual-Ranked Default: If this SDCA Function implements OpaqueSets and this Property is not present, then the Host shall assume that OpaqueSets for this SDCA Function are Single-Ranked.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-opaqueset-id-list
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating which OpaqueSets are present for this SDCA Function, with one integer entry for each OpaqueSet ID. Example: Package() {0x4, 0x22, 0x18, 0x11} Conditions: This Property shall be present if this SDCA Function implements any OpaqueSets.

Package.Name: Sdca_Opaqueset
Package.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to a package describing properties for each opaque set. n is encoded as a hexadecimal integer and there shall be one entry for each opaque set id mentioned in mipi-sdca-opaque-set-id-list. See new table for package contents.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-behavior-set-id-list
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating which Behavior Sets are present for this SDCA Function, with one integer entry for each Behavior Set ID. Example: Package() {0x19, 0x3, 0x6, 0x7} Conditions: This Property shall be present if this SDCA Function implements any Behavior Sets.

Package.Name: Sdca_Behaviorset
Package.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to a package describing properties for each behavior set. n is encoded as a hexadecimal integer and there shall be one entry for each behavior set id mentioned in mipi-sdca-behavior-set-id-list. See new table for package contents.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-file-set-id-list
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating which File Sets are available for this SDCA Function, with one integer entry for each File Set ID. Example: Package() {0x9, 0x32, 0x26, 0x17, 0x4} Conditions: This Property shall be present if any File Sets are available for this SDCA Function.

Package.Name: Sdca_Placeholder
Package.Description: This property provides a list of files that are permitted to be loaded into Entities within this Function, with reference to each file. n refers to the File Set Index provided by the mipi-sdca-file-set-id-list in the SDCA Specification and is encoded as a four-character string representing a hexadecimal number (0000-FFFF). See section 5.1.5 for a defintition of the SoundWire File Table. Package() { VendorID0, FileID0, File_Offset0, ... VendorID(n), FildID(n), File_Offset(n) }

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-function-busy-max-delay
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the maximum number of microseconds for which the Function_Busy signal will be asserted for this SDCA Function. If Function_Busy is asserted for longer than this period, then software may consider the SDCA Function to have failed. Default: If this Property is not present, then the Host shall assume that Function_Busy is not asserted.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-function-reset-max-delay
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the maximum number of microseconds for the Device Function to handle a Reset_Function_Now action. If Reset_Function_Now remains incomplete (i.e., is not cleared to 0) for longer than this period, then software may consider the SDCA Function to have failed. Conditions: This Property shall be present if this SDCA Function implements the Function_Action Control.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-string-table
Property.Description: This Subproperty shall contain the name of the object that contains a String Table (encoded as a Package) for this SDCA Function.

HierarchicalProperty.Name: mipi-sdca-function-expansion-subproperties
HierarchicalProperty.Description: This Subproperty shall contain the name of the object that contains Subproperties for an XU entity for this SDCA Function.

BufferProperty.Description: This Buffer Property shall contain the array of SoundWire register addresses and the values that need to be written to each such register to initialize this SDCA Function. Values: The format of the buffer is an array of pairs, where each pair contains a 32-bit register address and the 1-byte initialization value to write to that address. Within this array, the registers shall appear in order of ascending register address. Example: Buffer() { 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x02, 0x01, //Address 0x02000001, write value 0x01 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x03, 0x55, //Address 0x03000001, write value 0x55 }
This Buffer Property shall contain HID descriptors for this SDCA Function.
This Buffer Property shall contain HID reports for this SDCA Function.
This Buffer Property shall be an array of SoundWire register addresses and the values that need to be written to each such register when the software enters the inactive state.
This Buffer Property shall be an array of SoundWire register addresses and the values that need to be written to each such register when the software exits the inactive state.
